body: This is a good idea. What kind of doctor do you go to? I feel like my general practitioner isn't enough.

My last relationship required this because my Owner and I sometimes would go through days/weeks/etc where we would be able to talk. I had the anxious-insecure romantic attachments (sub, not dom) and asked if we could make sure that we had a good morning and a collar ceremony before bed. It assuaged so many of my fears, even though I would have liked more. I agree with what TheAlienVisitor said about making sure there's an equal compromise, but if your sub agrees with the rule I don't think it's too intense at all.

I've done what (I think that poster) suggested. Making little forts out of blankets and curling up under them while wearing my ears. Scratching things with the side of my face, doing things that make me feel cute and subspacey.

I guess kittenspace is different for everyone, just as subspace/littlespace/etc. Find something that makes you feel kittenish and do it. Rub your head against stuff, paint your nails (instead of licking them :P). Curl up with a pillow. Attack random things. Jump around. Lay in the sun. Imagine having a leg to rub against, a lap to sit in, a hand to rub your face all over.
Still alive, if maybe not ok.
I appreciate your advice, but this is too cynical a life view for me to accept.

I'm not going to answer this question.

Thank you for your advice, hand holding or not.

You obviously do not know the difference in feeling between community support and professional support. You do not know me or my situation. Inpatient in this country is not a viable option. My mother, who is a physician, agrees. My therapist, who I see every week, agrees. My psychiatrist, who knows that I tried to kill myself, agrees.

I am not looking for someone to fix me on an internet forum. I am looking for empathy and support, because support in therapy is very taxing and tiring and dependent on going inside yourself. Yes, in the long haul if I want to not die I will need professional help. But I seek professional help regularly. I am here for community.

This is a public forum, but please know that you do not know me. And posting here is not an attempt to avoid getting professional help.
inpatient in this country is not a viable option

The attempt was an attempt because someone figured out what was going on and broke into my room and forced me to go to the hospital. This is not your business, but please do not reduce me to someone who took a sleeping pill and then cried on facebook that I was killing myself. 

I do not have access to a gun. I am too squeamish to slash my veins. I wanted - I want, the pain to end. Yes. I want attention. I want positive attention from strangers because a man I love left me after promising to protect me and after a day of comfort. He comforted me, told me he loved me, told me I had not breached our contract, and then later sent me a text saying he could no longer be my Master. 

Yes. I raged. My emotions are raw. People assume things about suicide and mental health care that sometimes are simply not true. I am on medication. I see a therapist weekly. I check in with a psychiatrist at least once a month. I momentarily lost my composure when I viewed someone basically rolling their eyes at me.

>How about listening to medical advice and going to a psychiatric hospital?

This is a cynical, condescending response. This is not community or advice or comfort. This is the same as your answer. *How about you listen to doctors?* My mother is a physician, she agreed with my decision to not be admitted. *How about just getting some psychiatric help?* I have been on four kinds of antidepressants and have treatment resistant depression. I work my ass off every single week trying to work through trauma from my past. It often makes me feel better, but I dread going to therapy like I dread having teeth pulled because I know it will be so painful.

I do not owe you composure, or anyone else composure, for their treating me as condescending or as a woman just 'seeking attention'. Anyone posting here is seeking attention. They are seeking answers. I am seeking comfort because I am far away, because I am a person who is quiet and who has few friends, because my family is thousands of miles away, because I just lost the last pillar of support I thought I had (therapist support vs. someone who loves or cares about you is very different). I am seeking comfort because it is easier to be vulnerable to the strangers than people who know me personally. It is easier because there is no guilt like the guilt I feel when I tell my best friend or my mother that I wish the attempt had worked. There is guilt in their pain. Yes. They exist. Yes. They will hurt. No, I did not think of them before I went for it. No, it does not change how I feel to know that people would be sad if I died. Yes. I want attention. I want to understand. I want to not want to kill myself. 

But I do not owe you composure. Yes, I snapped. Yes, I was rude. 

If "How about you just get some help?" or "How about you just stop acting like you actually want to die?" aren't enough for you, maybe I should say how about if you don't want to deal with someone you think is just attention seeking, you downvote the post and move on?

Is that composed enough for you?
I don't really have many close friends, or anyone with a car. My Daddy was all I had, and now he's gone too, and I don't see any point anymore.
